name: Garni Gruber
beschreibung:
Situated in St. Johann in Tirol, Garni Gruber welcomes guests with traditional Tyrolean friendliness. Well-kept guestrooms provide a peaceful sanctuary after days spent outdoors in summer or winter.

Local ski lifts, access to the Kitzbueheler Horn, and cross-country ski trails are just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Bed & breakfast Garni Gruber in St. Johann in Tirol features friendly hospitality in the Kitzbuehel Alps.
